endorsements.name: David Lanzenberger
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-8109
endorsements.description: A vulnerability has been discovered in the ace.xmd parser that results from a lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a write past the end of an allocated buffer. This can result in denial-of-service. This issue affects: Bitdefender Engines version 7.84892 and prior versions.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.9)

endorsements.name: David Lanzenberger
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-8110
endorsements.description: A vulnerability has been discovered in the ceva_emu.cvd module that results from a lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a pointer that is fetched from uninitialized memory. This can lead to denial-of-service. This issue affects: Bitdefender Engines version 7.84897 and prior versions.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.9)
